findings.title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller CVE-2026-20182 (CVSS 10.0) — Authentication-Bypass Zero-Day Actively Exploited In The Wild; CISA KEV-Added With 3-Day Federal Deadline
findings.affected_technology: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller and Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager (on-prem and SD-WAN Cloud deployments)
findings.summary: An unauthenticated attacker reaching the SD-WAN management plane can bypass peering authentication via crafted requests and log in as an internal high-privileged non-root user, enabling rogue-peer injection and full SD-WAN fabric configuration manipulation; Rapid7 found the bug while researching the actively-exploited CVE-2026-20127 and Cisco confirmed in-the-wild zero-day exploitation prior to the 2026-05-14 disclosure.
findings.first_seen_at: bleepingcomputer.com / thehackernews.com — Cisco warns of new critical SD-WAN flaw exploited in zero-day attacks (2026-05-14)

findings.title: F5 NGINX 'NGINX Rift' CVE-2026-42945 — 18-Year-Old Heap Buffer Overflow In ngx_http_rewrite_module (CVSS 9.2) Becomes Pre-Auth RCE With ASLR Disabled; Full F5 Quarterly Advisory Lands With 50+ CVEs
findings.affected_technology: F5 NGINX Open Source 0.6.27–1.30.0; NGINX Plus R32–R36 + derivatives (OpenResty, Tengine, Angie, Kong, NGINX Ingress Controller)
findings.summary: F5's full quarterly advisory raises the NGINX rewrite-module bug from limited-detail oss-security note to CVSS 9.2 named 'NGINX Rift' — heap overflow when configs combine 'rewrite' and 'set' directives because the is_args flag persists across NGINX's two-pass script engine, enabling unauthenticated DoS and (with ASLR disabled or specific gadget chains) remote code execution; discovered April 2026 by DepthFirst AI autonomous code scanning, patched in 1.31.0/1.30.1 and NGINX Plus R36 P4 / R32 P6.
findings.first_seen_at: securityweek.com / bleepingcomputer.com — F5 Patches Over 50 Vulnerabilities; 18-Year-Old NGINX Vulnerability (2026-05-14)

findings.title: Burst Statistics WordPress Plugin CVE-2026-8181 (CVSS 9.8) — Authentication Bypass Actively Exploited Against 115K+ Vulnerable Sites; Wordfence Blocked 7,400 Attacks In 24 Hours
findings.affected_technology: Burst Statistics WordPress plugin 3.4.0 and 3.4.1 (~200,000 active installs; ~115,000 sites unpatched)
findings.summary: Burst Statistics misinterprets the wp_authenticate_application_password() return value — WP_Error and null responses are treated as success — letting an unauthenticated attacker impersonate any admin via REST API and create rogue administrator accounts; patched in 3.4.2 (2026-05-12) and exploited in the wild within 48h with Wordfence reporting 7,400+ attack attempts in a 24h window.
findings.first_seen_at: bleepingcomputer.com / dbugs.ptsecurity.com — Hackers exploit auth bypass flaw in Burst Statistics WordPress plugin (2026-05-14)

findings.title: Linux Kernel 'Fragnesia' CVE-2026-46300 — Public PoC Released With No Race Condition; Dirty-Frag Patch Sequel With LPE-To-Root via Page-Cache Write
findings.affected_technology: Linux kernel — XFRM ESP-in-TCP subsystem (all distributions with pre-2026-05-13 kernels)
findings.summary: Yesterday's Noted 'fragnesia / copyfail 3.0' kernel LPE now has CVE-2026-46300, public PoC on GitHub (v12-security repo), and no-race-condition exploitation — unprivileged local users write arbitrary bytes to the kernel page cache of read-only files (demonstrated against /usr/bin/su for root shell); same CopyFail lineage previously escalated into CISA KEV via CVE-2026-31431.
findings.first_seen_at: bleepingcomputer.com / securityweek.com / helpnetsecurity.com — New Fragnesia Linux flaw lets attackers gain root privileges (2026-05-14)

findings.title: PraisonAI CVE-2026-44338 — Legacy Flask API Auth Disabled By Default; First Exploitation Attempts Within 4 Hours Of Public Disclosure
findings.affected_technology: PraisonAI multi-agent orchestration framework — legacy Flask API server
findings.summary: The PraisonAI legacy Flask API ships with authentication disabled by default, letting unauthenticated callers invoke protected agent-orchestration API functions; SecurityWeek reports first exploitation attempts observed within 4 hours of public disclosure — third PraisonAI advisory in 30 days after the April batch and 2026-05-12 CVE-2026-44336 path-traversal/RCE.
findings.first_seen_at: thehackernews.com / securityweek.com — Hackers Targeted PraisonAI Vulnerability Hours After Disclosure (2026-05-14)

findings.title: node-ipc npm Versions 9.1.6 / 9.2.3 / 12.0.1 — Obfuscated Stealer Backdoor Fingerprints Systems And Exfiltrates Developer Credentials + Cloud Secrets
findings.affected_technology: node-ipc npm package — malicious versions 9.1.6, 9.2.3, 12.0.1 (transitive in many Electron/Node tooling stacks)
findings.summary: Three npm package versions of node-ipc were found to contain obfuscated malware that fingerprints the host, harvests developer credentials and cloud-provider secrets, and exfiltrates to attacker C2 — same broader npm supply-chain pattern as Mini Shai-Hulud Wave 2 but on a separate package and without the trusted-publisher-signing twist; pin to known-good versions and audit CI logs for compromised version IDs.
findings.first_seen_at: thehackernews.com — Stealer Backdoor in Node-IPC Versions (2026-05-14)

findings.title: KongTuke IAB Pivots To Microsoft Teams Helpdesk-Impersonation Chain — 5-Minute Foothold; 8th Actor In 30 Days In The Teams-SE → MFA-Tamper Pattern
findings.affected_technology: Microsoft Teams external chat surface; ModeloRAT (KongTuke's commodity RAT)
findings.summary: KongTuke (initial-access broker) added Microsoft Teams external-chat IT-helpdesk impersonation to its FileFix/CrashFix lure portfolio, abusing Unicode whitespace tricks to spoof display names and rotating five Microsoft 365 tenants for evasion — single chat moves operator from cold outreach to persistent foothold in under 5 minutes; eighth actor in 30 days documented in the Teams-helpdesk-impersonation → MFA-tamper → RMM-persistence chain after BlackFile, SNOW/UNC6692, Cordial Spider, Snarky Spider, Microsoft Code-of-Conduct AiTM, VENOMOUS#HELPER, MuddyWater.

Command injection via unsanitized argument substitution + full-process-env exposure to CLI subprocess (GHSA 2026-05-14); niche CLI tool.

Four-CVE deepseek-tui batch: RCE via prompt injection in project files + run_tests tool accepting malicious repos + SSRF via IPv6 bypass + SSRF via HTTP redirect bypass — yet another AI-coding-assistant trust-boundary class joining Claude Code MCP / TrustFall / ClaudeBleed.

Injection vulnerability in full-text search regConfig parameter (GHSA 2026-05-14); .NET data-access library.
